# DGSDK - Dongguan Shidike Automation Equipment Co., Ltd.

> DGSDK focuses on industrial static eliminators and ionizing bars first, followed by precision cleaning machines for production lines worldwide.

## Products

- [Industrial Static Eliminators and Ionizing Bars](https://www.dg-sdk.com/products/static-eliminator): Primary product line covering ionizing bars, static eliminator bars, ionizer fans, and ionizing air blowers for ESD-sensitive manufacturing and moving-material processes.
- [Industrial Cleaning Machines](https://www.dg-sdk.com/products/cleaning-machine): Second product line covering dry-contact cleaners for polarizer, optical film, PCB, FPC, SMT, backlight, LCM, and related precision substrates.

## Company

- Founded: 2013
- Location: Dongguan, Guangdong, China
- Market: Worldwide; English and Chinese sales support
- Specialization: Industrial static control first, precision surface cleaning second
- Integration support: Mounting, material handling, controls, and production-line interfaces for static control and cleaning projects
- Contact: dgsdk2013@gmail.com | +86 13602342003
